ops.body:
Open: the hatch's look (density, angle, edge width), candidates side by side on the web build, the owner picking (decision 0235's review, I4: a look call is never the builder's).
  Done when: on the owner's scene re-shot (a navigated walk into car ground, Walkability and Storefronts on, the heads-up showing, 390 px), a reader who has not seen the legend can say which ground is built around cars and where the line points.

- **G? [M] Tend: an area leaves rough when what is open allows it, and the balance acts both ways** (2026-11-19) · no surface · the owner's calls
  Area: process (tend). From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-19), a fresh-context review of the tend orchestration. Brief: docs/research/tend-process-review.md.
  Calls: rough is what is left open, with a three-sweep backstop; the balance reads shares, with an actuator each way; the whole inbox counts. Decision 0235.
  Done when: replayed over the run log of Nov 11-19, the script reads walk-screen as settling after its whole sweep (all seven mediums shipped), and the balance reads other than "outgrowing its base".
  The slice: 1. `scripts/tend.js` computes an area's state after a run from what is open (an open high or medium: rough; only lows, or the area's [owner] or [arch] entries waiting: settling; a whole sweep leaving nothing above low open, with a journey per screen: polished); a 0229 reset still makes it rough; the run writes the script's state, never its own judgement. 2. Three whole sweeps of an area with no reset between them make it settling at least, its lows going to DEFERRED instead of being found again. 3. The balance reads rough as a share of swept areas and shows never-swept areas apart as "unseen"; a first sweep no longer raises the alarm by itself. 4. Fourteen days with no loop-filed G while an area is settling or polished: the reading says so and the next run is `evolve` for that area. 5. `/slice` step 1 says "lands on a rough base" with the area's open medium and high items, and the slice's record says whether it left the area no rougher; a warning, never a block. 6. `balance` and `next` exit non-zero, saying why, when the window's commits are missing (a shallow clone), instead of a wrong reading. 7. The balance reads every item under "Needs the owner", not only T and G entries. 8. Tests for each, the run log of Nov 11-19 replayed as a fixture. 9. tend/SKILL.md sections 0, 8 and 9, and the orchestrator's stop rule, say the same.
  Precedent: SRE error budgets judge what is open, not what was found; Shape Up's appetite caps a pass; docs/research/agentic-process-framework.md 2.4-2.5 (sources there, most unverified).
  Payoff: the loop can propose again, and its states start to mean something; the owner's slices see the base they land on. Cost: M; scripts/tend.js, its tests, three skills. Reopens: tend. After it: G7.
  Instead: only criteria 1, 3 and 6 (the state from what is open, shares, the shallow guard).

- **G? [M] Tend: a budget for review, rotation onto unseen areas, an answer log, and no racing** (2026-11-19) · no surface · the owner's calls
  Area: process (tend). From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-19). Brief: docs/research/tend-process-review.md. After: G6 (rotation only raises the alarm until areas can leave rough).
  Calls: one review fix per fix; the whole inbox counted, the oldest asked first, 30-day expiry; a lease on process files and decision numbers at publish; no process stop share. Decision 0235.
  Done when: a week of runs after it shows review fixes at or under the runs' own fixes, at least two never-swept areas swept, and every answer logged with who gave it.
  The slice: 1. `check:tend` fails a range whose `tend <area> audit N` commits outnumber its `tend <area> N` and `T<n>` commits, unless the extra commit's message names a regression the run caused; findings over the budget are filed with their severity. 2. `next` alternates: the most-reset area, then the never-swept or longest-unswept area, in VISION's verb order (Return, Honour, Earn), each area's verb in `scripts/features.js`. 3. Every `answers` item in the run log carries `by` (owner or proxy) and `pick` (recommended, other, reshape, no); `tend.js log` refuses one without them. 4. `balance` prints, over 30 days and by entry class, the owner's take-up of the recommended option and the proxy's yeses the owner has not confirmed; delegating stays the owner's call (0157). 5. `npm run records -- inbox age` lists items unanswered for 14 days, the orchestrator asks the four oldest first, and an item unanswered for 30 days moves to DEFERRED as [owner] with its words kept. 6. A session changing process files (skills, hooks, process scripts, AGENTS.md) holds a row in "In flight" naming them, for 24 h; another branch's commit to a held file is refused by a check, and the owner can clear a row. 7. Decision numbers are taken at publish (`book:next-decision` in "Publish to main"), a provisional name until then. 8. Tests for each; ship.md, tend/SKILL.md, the orchestrator skill and briefs.md say the same.
  Precedent: Shape Up lets an unchosen pitch lapse; Linear's triage; docs/research/agentic-process-framework.md 2.4, 2.7 (most sources unverified).
  Payoff: review stops outrunning the work it reviews; the unseen half of the app is swept; the owner's answers become data. Cost: M; scripts/tend.js, scripts/records.js, scripts/bookkeeping.js, four skill files. Reopens: tend, records. After it: walk notes, if the owner wants them (the brief's "Left out").
  Instead: only criteria 1, 3 and 7.
